claim: In provisioned mode, each shard supports up to 1 MB/sec or 1,000 records/sec of write throughput, and up to 2 MB/sec or 2,000 records/sec of read throughput. Maximum throughput of a provisioned stream depends on the number of shards.
question: What write and read throughput does one shard of a provisioned Kinesis data stream support?

qualifiers.condition: provisioned capacity mode; scale by adding shards
